commands:

git fetch origin
git checkout integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903

[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "a5ad4d5cf5d9faf8c12de571ea088a4b6e2893e3" ]
printf '%s\n' '=== esp_zigbee config ==='
grep -R -n -B20 -A80 -E 'typedef struct esp_zigbee_config|esp_zigbee_config_t|zed_config|ed_config' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include esp-zigbee* 2>/dev/null | head -n 260 || true
printf '%s\n' '=== basic creator/config ==='
grep -n -B20 -A80 -E 'basic_cluster_server_config|basic_create_cluster_desc|basic_cluster_desc_add_attr' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/cluster/basic_desc.h
printf '%s\n' '=== attribute set/report ==='
grep -R -n -B12 -A30 -E 'set_attr|set_attribute|report_attr|report_attribute|attr.*value.*set|update.*attr' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/{af.h,zcl} | head -n 360 || true

grep -R -n -E 'DEVICE_TYPE_END|END_DEVICE|CLUSTER_SERVER|PRIMARY_CHANNEL|set_primary_channel' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee | head -n 220
